if ! swiftformat --lint . > /dev/null 2>&1

  echo "pre-commit: Commit aborted due to SwiftFormat warnings. Please check the automatically generated fixes and try again"

  exit 1

	"$LOCAL_SCRIPT_PATH"
fi

content.Text:
Here are the scripts to copy-paste:

---

**`~/.local/fandomfaceoff_local_dev/check_staged_strings.sh`** -- the general utility:

> #!/bin/bash
> # Usage: check_staged_strings.sh [--file <path-pattern>] <string1> [string2 ...]
> # Exits 1 if any staged diff (added lines) contains any of the given strings.
> 
> FILE_PATTERN=""
> if [ "$1" = "--file" ]; then
>     FILE_PATTERN="$2"
>     shift 2
> fi
> 
> STRINGS=("$@")
> FOUND=0
> 
> if [ -n "$FILE_PATTERN" ]; then
>     DIFF=$(git diff --cached -- "$FILE_PATTERN")
> else
>     DIFF=$(git diff --cached)
> fi
> 
> for STR in "${STRINGS[@]}"; do
>     MATCHES=$(echo "$DIFF" | grep "^+" | grep -v "^+++" | grep -F "$STR")
>     if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then
>         echo "pre-commit: Staged changes contain forbidden string '$STR':"
>         echo "$MATCHES"
>         FOUND=1
>     fi
> done
> 
> exit $FOUND

---

**`~/.local/fandomfaceoff_local_dev/pre-commit`** -- your specific checks:

> #!/bin/bash
> 
> SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
> REPO="${FANDOM_REPO:-$(pwd)}"
> FAILED=0
> 
> # Check project.pbxproj staged diff for "Trek"
> "$SCRIPT_DIR/check_staged_strings.sh" --file "*.pbxproj" "Trek"
> if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
>     FAILED=1
> fi
> 
> # Check if project.yml is staged at all
> if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q "project.yml"; then
>     echo "pre-commit: project.yml is staged -- make sure this is intentional."
>     FAILED=1
> fi
> 
> exit $FAILED

---

Make sure both are executable (`chmod +x` on each). One thing worth noting: the `project.yml` check warns on *any* staged change to that file, not just specific strings.
